summary: Solve 18 original picture puzzles with attached clues, saved undo and larger grids.
page_description: Pan larger grids, inspect full clues and keep your marks and undo history when reopening.
release_notes: The play header drops cursor coordinates - the outlined square shows your place - and keeps the marks counter; zoomed windows still name their rows and columns when the focus leaves the view.

steps.text: The bundled puzzles play straight away. To make one from a photo:
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Turn a photo into a puzzle and send it.
